question: By what factor does scaled dot-product attention divide query-key dot products?
answer: In Scaled Dot-Product Attention, the query-key dot products are divided by $\sqrt{d_k}$ [P1]. This scaling factor is applied to counteract the effect of dot products growing large in magnitude for large values of $d_k$, which would otherwise push the softmax function into regions with extremely small gradients [P1][P2]. The attention function is computed as $\text{Attention}(Q, K, V) = \text{softmax}(QK^T / \sqrt{d_k})V$ [P1].
